protocol.selection: base cost only; positive median, >=10 fills total, positive >=4/5 segments, max DD <=4%; maximize mean return minus worst DD; otherwise cash
protocol.partitions: original first 50% warm/train, next 25% validation ONLY; old final 25% was previously exposed and is not fresh untouched evidence
protocol.new_final_holdout: fresh post-2026-10-22T21:00Z data sealed separately; not evaluated by this study

latency_model: close decision, next hourly open; no intra-bar order book, actual matching latency or maker fills assumed
